comparison.objective: Remove a chipped drone propeller and install a replacement using its threaded nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual blade stabilization, nut turning, removal, keyed placement, tightening, and disposal; no percussive fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Old propeller is binned, replacement is printed-side up on the same motor, nut is tight, and arms retreat; torque and damage thresholds are not stated.
comparison.reason: This is a close manipulation neighbor, but it tests reversible threaded disassembly/reassembly rather than impact-induced notch fracture and recovery of four tiny released tangs.
